Conventional platforms such as PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable, leaving creators with limited options. Fortunately, by deploying your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies for your sales, empowering you to bypass these limitations altogether.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

When platforms like Stripe and PayPal restrict access, you need an infrastructure that operates independently of them. The COREMERCH solution leverages decentralized payment processing through NOWPayments, allowing you to accept Bitcoin and over 300 other cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, just 0.5%. This system not only bypasses traditional payment barriers but also gives you complete ownership of your revenue, ensuring you retain more profits compared to platforms that charge hefty fees, such as Gumroad's 10% per sale.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign commerce stack, ensure that you have a few essential tools. You'll need a domain name to host your store, which can be acquired from any registrar. Set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your site. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend operations. Having a NOWPayments account ready will facilitate seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or templates, for upload.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your chosen hosting service. If using Google Apps Script, write scripts to handle payment verification and automate product delivery via a secure link. For Cloudflare Workers, configure your pipeline to ensure that payment confirmations trigger the delivery of digital files instantly. By automating this process, you enhance the customer experience and streamline your operations, ensuring that purchases are fulfilled without manual intervention.
Eliminate high platform fees and keep more of your earnings.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your pipeline is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your website and test your store by processing a small transaction. Make sure to go through the entire buying process to iron out any issues. Check that customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation. This step is crucial to ensure everything works smoothly before you start promoting your ebooks more broadly. Once tested, you can confidently market your products knowing the infrastructure is robust.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Track your sales and customer feedback to identify popular products. Use data analytics to refine your marketing strategies. You can increase your product range or optimize your website for better conversion rates. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers additional resources, including blueprints and templates, to help you scale effectively, ensuring that your infrastructure can handle increased demand without compromising service.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using COREMERCH's infrastructure. This allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing conventional platforms. You gain full ownership of your sales process and can retain significantly more revenue than through platforms that charge high transaction fees.
Own your entire sales process with no dependencies on third-party platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

Acquire a domain name to host your store. Set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website. Create a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency transactions. Prepare your digital products for upload. Write backend scripts using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for payment processing and delivery. Test your store by processing a small transaction to ensure everything works as expected.
